weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X (for unit, X = 15; for allies, X = 5), and grants Special cooldown count-1 before each of unit's or ally's attacks during combat (including when unit or ally attacks twice or performs a follow-up attack), and also, if unit's or ally's Spd > foe's Spd, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's or ally's follow-up attacks during combat.
Unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials). If unit's Spd > foe's Spd or unit's Res > foe's Res, unit attacks twice during combat.
After combat initiated by unit and after subsequent【Cadenza】combat, enables 【Cadenza】against any foe within three spaces of unit (up to twice per turn; does not trigger if【Cadenza】is used against foes four or more spaces away from unit).
【Cadenza】
After combat initiated by unit (after post-combat skills are triggered; before post-action skills and Canto are triggered; Penalty effects that last through unit's action are neutralized), unit can attack foe again once, within a specified distance, regardless of unit's Range.
Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe can counterattack regardless of unit's Range, unit's Range = foe's Range, or foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and foe. Skill effect's Range is determined by unit's weapon's Range. Unit's space before movement and unit's remaining movement referenced by the skill remain the same as before Cadenza. Unit cannot move, use Style, or attack structures; unit's area-of-effect Specials cannot be triggered, and after-combat movement effects do not occur. If unit uses Cadenza on foe that is within range of another Cadenza effect, Cadenza is treated as if having been triggered, including the other effect. Only highest value applied; does not stack. Does not trigger when affected by effects of Foresight Snare or traps in Aether Raids. Cadenza can be used only once per turn for player team in Summoner Duels. Does not trigger in Pawns of Loki.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.

Boosts damage by X% of unit's Atk when Special triggers (if【Penalty】effects are active on foe, X = 80; otherwise, X = 70).
If unit initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's attacks by 40% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and also, if foe has any【Penalty】effects active, grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack during combat.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

a.d:
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+10.
Enables Canto (Dist.; Max 3, Min 1).
Unit can move through foes' spaces.
Disables foe's effects that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res" (including area-of-effect Specials).
Unit can move to a space within 2 spaces of support partner or allies with the【Bonded】 effect active.
For each foe on the map who has already entered combat, unit can move to the nearest spaces that are 2 spaces away from those foes (unless space is impassable terrain).
At start of turn, if there is no support partner on the map, grants【Bonded】to allies with highest Spd on player team at start of battle for 1 turn ("at start of battle" excludes increases to Spd granted after ally is deployed, such as Legendary Effects, Mythic Effects, Bonus Heroes, Great Talent, etc.).
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants【Anathema】and【Empathy】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Unit deals +7 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If unit triggers Cadenza or if foe has entered combat aside from this combat on this map, unit deals an additional +15 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and decreases Spd difference necessary for unit to make a follow-up attack by 10 during combat, and also, if unit initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's first attack to a maximum of 1 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
If unit's HP > 1 and foe would reduce unit's HP to 0, unit survives with 1 HP (once per combat; does not stack with non-Special effects that allow unit to survive with 1 HP if foe's attack would reduce HP to 0).
【Bonded】
Grants a status that can trigger certain skill effects to unit.
【Anathema】
Inflicts Spd/Def/Res-4 on foes within 3 spaces of unit during combat.
【Empathy】
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of types of Bonus effects, excluding stat bonuses, and Penalty effects, excluding stat penalties, active on player team and enemy team during combat (max 7).

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-2 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-4 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd/Res-6 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

For foes on the map whose Res < unit's Res at start of combat, inflicts Spd/Res-5, neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res, and foe suffers +10 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Inflicts Spd/Res-4 on foe, and unit deals +8 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

c.d: Inflicts Spd/Res-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.

At start of player phase or enemy phase, if any foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit have Res < unit's Res+5, inflicts 【Exposure】and【Discord】on those foes through their next actions.
For foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, inflicts Spd/Res-5 and reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special "reduce damage by X%" skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Unit deals +5 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.
【Exposure】
Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.
【Discord】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X on unit during combat (X = 2 + number of allies within 2 spaces of unit; max 5).
